steps.en: Diplomat/military notices are temporarily suspended under a set code and period
steps.id: Notice diplomat/militer ditangguhkan sementara dengan kode dan periode tertentu
steps.why_en: They are suspended permanently at the third reminder stage, with no period.
steps.why_id: Notice ditangguhkan permanen di tahap reminder ketiga, tanpa periode.

steps.en: The report is generated quarterly, every three months
steps.id: Report dibuat secara quarterly, tiap tiga bulan
steps.why_en: Reports only run daily or monthly; there is no quarterly schedule.
steps.why_id: Report hanya berjalan harian atau bulanan; tidak ada jadwal quarterly.

steps.en: The report lists notices temporarily suspended under that specific code
steps.id: Report memuat notice yang ditangguhkan sementara dengan kode tertentu itu
steps.why_en: No such report exists; the nearest list screen is switched off.
steps.why_id: Report seperti itu tidak ada; layar daftar terdekat dimatikan.

steps.en: The report shows notice number, name, entity, address, offence time, car park, amount
steps.id: Report menampilkan nomor notice, nama, entity, alamat, waktu offence, car park, jumlah
steps.why_en: The nearest report lacks offence time, car park and amount payable.
steps.why_id: Report terdekat tidak punya waktu offence, car park, dan jumlah yang harus dibayar.

steps.en: The report is routed to the officer's dashboard
steps.why_en: The dashboard is empty and no delivery exists for this report.
steps.why_id: Dashboard kosong dan tidak ada pengiriman untuk report ini.

steps.en: The officer downloads the report for reference
steps.why_en: A generic download exists, but this report does not, so nothing to download.
steps.why_id: Fitur unduh umum ada, tetapi report ini tidak ada sehingga tidak ada yang diunduh.
